YOUR SHIPPING GUIDE

A clear path.
From first enquiry to arrival.

Your first shipment or your next one—get the essentials in place before the goods start moving.

CHINA ⟶ NIGERIA
01
START THE CONVERSATION

Tell us what’s moving.

Describe the goods, number of packages, approximate weight, dimensions, destination city, and any timing needs. Mention special contents such as batteries, liquids, or fragile items.

02
AGREE THE ARRANGEMENTS

Confirm the details.

Discuss sea or air freight, current pricing, what the charges include, and expected timing. Get the correct receiving instructions before your supplier dispatches anything.

03
PREPARE YOUR PACKAGES

Label every piece.

Ask your supplier to write your customer name, phone number, and destination city clearly on each package. Confirm any additional shipping mark and packaging requirements with the team.

04
HAND OVER IN CHINA

Coordinate with the receiving team.

Confirm the delivery address and receiving hours. Keep the supplier’s dispatch details and ask the team how receipt of your goods will be confirmed.

05
STAY IN TOUCH

Arrange the Nigeria handover.

Contact the team for shipment updates. Confirm the collection office, any remaining charges, and what you need to bring before travelling to collect your goods.

READY TO GET STARTED?

Your enquiry checklist

  • Product description
  • Number of packages
  • Weight or dimensions
  • Destination city
  • Preferred shipping method
  • Your contact details
